methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Pre-Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Solideon is a pre-seed robotics and manufacturing company founded by Oluseun Taiwo that has raised $6.5M to date. The broader robotics and manufacturing sector includes 9 comparable companies (1 public, 8 private), though peer companies include names such as Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

The primary valuation method applied is stage-progression analysis, which is applicable given Solideon's pre-seed positioning. Using the $6.5M total raised as a proxy for current implicit value and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of pre-seed to seed-stage progression, the method implies a valuation of $16.3M. Peer-median triangulation was not applicable due to insufficient comparable data; while 10 peers exist in robotics and manufacturing broadly, fewer than three filtered to same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier comparables, making median-based inference unreliable at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13.8M to $18.7M, with a median point of $16.3M. This range reflects a single-method triangulation and carries material uncertainty inherent to pre-seed stage valuation, where limited financial performance data and narrow peer comparability constrain precision. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to eventual seed-stage cohorts and sector-specific risk factors in robotics development timelines.
